items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: this very good friend of mine... is now one of the greatest... jazz drummers, Brian Blade. And we went to junior high school together and we played together.

ctx.x: Right. Okay. What brought you to New Orleans, and did you decide when you were pretty young that you were going to be a musician?

I did, or at least I started playing music when I was nine. I started playing the bass when I was nine. And I don’t know if at the very beginning I felt like oh this is definitely what I’m going to do for my life, be a musician. But it was probably the primary focus of my life, and just has always been with me. It started at nine, loved playing the bass, started studying classical music and orchestra at school, and then when I got to high school I got introduced to my stage band, and listened to some of my…
Can you remember the first time you made money playing a gig, and how much was it?
